rev.t: I was a little nervous to join a theater workshop, but this was the best decision I’ve made in a while. The 3 weekend format was perfectly paced, and the instructors did a great job of creating a supportive space to learn and play. I had so much fun and met some great people. Thank you for such a fantastic experience!

Did the 6 day weekday workshop.. attended just for curiousity but learnt so much about myself and triggered my creative side..it was fun and an eye opener.. we learnt few techniques and nuances abt theatre and i am looking fwd to further association with YTT..Thank you Mohan and Akaansh .

What a place to learn!! Strongly recommend if you've been toying with the idea of doing theatre but not finding the right place to start. It's a safe space to unlock your creative juices and try something new :)
